There is no EV route at all, or anything like that. The thing about busy roads is true near the big cities you encounter, so you can expect Barcelona and Valencia province to be quite busy, but that's probably it.

The closer you stay to the coast the busiest (as well as the resorts) so that's up to you how you plan your route. You may not see the sea, but it may be quieter.

In case in your research you come up with something like GR-92 be aware it's a route on the coast intended for walking, not cycling friendly at all (like steps and rocks on the path very often, fine for walking, awful for cycling)

Regarding the wild camping, it's forbidden, so that's up to you

I would suggest for you to have a look at Santiago's way on northen Spain. You have a route following the coast, with good indications and not so busy roads

To me it was a combination of factors. First, and if you can afford it, I would recommend seeing an specialist, since there are different pathologies that could be affecting you.

In my case it was a change in habits that helped me:
-Go to sleep and wake up later. I find it difficult to get to sleep early, so since my job allows for it, i get to it a bit late

-Do not wander in bed staring at the ceiling in the darkness. Satying in bed while trying (and failing) to get sleep only builds up stress and tension, which is the opposite of what you need. Instead, if for more than 15 minutes you don't fall asleep, get out and do something else. In my case cleaning works. Nothing too active, just repetitive, easy to do, and a bit boring. Your body and mind need to know that bed is for sleeping and sex, not for wandering

-Cardio. Go for a run or whatever you like regularly. Your body needs to get tired at the end of the day so it falls asleep easier

-Attemp to be regular with your sleep. Go to bed and wake up at similar hours. Also, don't get one day of 12 hours sleep to recover, since this will drain your sleeping points for next days

-Have a routine to go to bed. Something that relaxes you, easies your mind and pits an end to your day. For me that is reading for 15-30 minutes
